title: NotificationTargetActions
description: Specifies an AWS Lambda function to manage alarm notifications. You can create one or use the AWS Lambda function provided by AWS IoT Events.

allOf.description: The ARN of the Lambda function that is executed.
You can configure the action payload when you send a message to a Lambda function.

lambdaAction.description: Calls a Lambda function, passing in information about the detector model instance and the event that triggered the action.
